verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing is API-driven, so it can be automated without a UI: cards are created and updated through API resources such as paymentInstrument and /paymentInstruments/{id}, events arrive as webhooks, and test verification failures can be forced for testing. However, some setup still requires the Customer Area UI, including configuring relayed authorisation webhooks and uploading dispute files. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless tooling, documented CI/test-environment workflows, API-only configuration of relayed authorisation and dispute uploads, and independent hands-on corroboration.
